theorem mobiusMertens_subpower_of_zeroFree {Θ : ℝ} (hΘ : (1 : ℝ) / 2 ≤ Θ) (hΘ1 : Θ ≤ 1)
    (hzf : ∀ z : ℂ, Θ < z.re → riemannZeta z ≠ 0) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ N : ℕ,
      ‖mobiusMertensPartialSum N‖ ≤ C * ((N : ℝ) + 1) ^ (Θ + ε)

    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ N : ℕ,
      ‖mobiusMertensPartialSum N‖ ≤ C * ((N : ℝ) + 1) ^ (Θ + ε)
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  have hsubpower := partialSumSeq_subpower_of_smoothPerron
    (b := fun n => (ArithmeticFunction.moebius n : ℂ)) (Θ := Θ)
    (fun n => by
      rw [← Complex.ofReal_intCast, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact_mod_cast ArithmeticFunction.abs_moebius_le_one (n := n))
    (by linarith)
    (fun dl a hdl hdl1 ha => by
      obtain ⟨Kb, hKb, hFdiff, hFbd⟩ :=
        exists_invZeta_shift_data_of_zeroFree hΘ hΘ1 hzf hdl hdl1 ha (2 : ℝ)
      refine ⟨invZeta, Kb, hKb, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro y
        have hline : (((Θ + dl : ℝ)) : ℂ) + (y : ℝ) * I ∈ verticalStrip (Θ + dl) 2 :=
          line_mem_verticalStrip le_rfl (by linarith) y
        simpa using hFbd _ hline
      · intro N H hN hH
        have hc : 0 < Θ + dl := by linarith
        have hc2 : Θ + dl ≤ 2 := by linarith
        refine ⟨integrable_mul_mellin_smoothWeight_line hN hH hc hFdiff.continuousOn
          hKb ha.le hFbd le_rfl hc2, ?_⟩
        exact mobius_perron_shift_of_zeroFree hΘ hΘ1 hzf hdl hdl1 ha hN hH)
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hbound⟩ := hsubpower ε hε
  refine ⟨C, hC.le, fun N => ?_⟩
  simpa [partialSumSeq, mobiusMertensPartialSum, mobiusComplexCoefficient] using hbound N

source_arguments.statement:
theorem frequently_rpow_le_rawMixed_moebius {j : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop,
      ((N : ℝ) + 1) ^ ((j : ℝ) + 1 - 1 - ε)
        ≤ (mixedAdditiveConvolutionPower moebiusCoeffC (j + 1) N).re
source_arguments.source_statement:
theorem frequently_rpow_le_rawMixed_moebius {j : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop,
      ((N : ℝ) + 1) ^ ((j : ℝ) + 1 - 1 - ε)
        ≤ (mixedAdditiveConvolutionPower moebiusCoeffC (j + 1) N).re
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  by_contra hcon
  rw [Filter.not_frequently] at hcon
  set α : ℝ := (j : ℝ) + 1 - 1 - ε with hαdef
  set lam : ℝ := max α 0 with hlamdef
  have hlam0 : 0 ≤ lam := le_max_right _ _
  have hjR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (j : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hj
  have hev : ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop,
      (mixedAdditiveConvolutionPower moebiusCoeffC (j + 1) N).re ≤ ((N : ℝ) + 1) ^ lam := by
    filter_upwards [hcon] with N hN
    have hbase : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) + 1 := by
      have := Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) N
      linarith
    refine le_trans (le_of_lt (not_le.mp hN)) ?_
    exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hbase (le_max_left _ _)
  obtain ⟨C, hC0, hCbound⟩ :=
    GaloisForLFunctions.HTGeometry.exists_global_subpower_of_eventually_le hlam0 hev
  have hkey := zetaZeroAbscissa_le_of_rawMixed_subpower (k := j + 1) (Nat.succ_pos j)
    hlam0 hC0 hCbound
  have hcast : ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (j : ℝ) + 1 := by push_cast; ring
  rw [hcast, le_div_iff₀ (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * ((j : ℝ) + 1))] at hkey
  have hΘ := half_le_zetaZeroAbscissa
  rcases le_or_gt α 0 with h | h
  · rw [hlamdef, max_eq_right h] at hkey
    nlinarith [hkey, hΘ]
  · rw [hlamdef, max_eq_left h.le, hαdef] at hkey
    nlinarith [hkey, hΘ]

      ¬ (∀ M : ℕ, (mixedAdditiveConvolutionPower a k M).re ≤ C * ((M : ℝ) + 1) ^ α))

source_arguments.source_statement:
theorem frequently_lt_of_no_subpower {a : ℕ → ℂ} {k : ℕ} {α : ℝ}
    (hno : ∀ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C →
      ¬ (∀ M : ℕ, (mixedAdditiveConvolutionPower a k M).re ≤ C * ((M : ℝ) + 1) ^ α))
    (C : ℝ) :
    ∃ᶠ M : ℕ in atTop,
      C * ((M : ℝ) + 1) ^ α < (mixedAdditiveConvolutionPower a k M).re
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  by_contra hcon
  rw [Filter.not_frequently] at hcon
  obtain ⟨M₀, hM₀⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp hcon
  have hout : ∀ M : ℕ, M ∉ Finset.range M₀ →
      (mixedAdditiveConvolutionPower a k M).re ≤ max C 0 * ((M : ℝ) + 1) ^ α := by
    intro M hM
    have hMle : M₀ ≤ M := by
      by_contra hlt'
      exact hM (Finset.mem_range.mpr (not_le.mp hlt'))
    have hb := not_lt.mp (hM₀ M hMle)
    have hpow : (0 : ℝ) < ((M : ℝ) + 1) ^ α := by positivity
    have hmax : C * ((M : ℝ) + 1) ^ α ≤ max C 0 * ((M : ℝ) + 1) ^ α :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) hpow.le
    linarith
  obtain ⟨C', hC', hglob⟩ := exists_global_subpower (le_max_right C 0) (Finset.range M₀) hout
  exact hno C' hC' hglob

## Universal law

For every pair of primes `p,q` and every cutoff `N`, palindromic reversal energies computed from
the `p`-free and `q`-free windows agree exactly. For any single chosen prime, window-energy
subpower criterion is equivalent to global Mertens palindromic-energy criterion and therefore
implies RH.

Substitute exact prime-window formula for both Mertens partial sums in every antidiagonal summand
of palindromic energy. This proves energy identity termwise for each prime. Transporting pointwise
identity through quantified subpower bound gives criterion equivalence. Existing positive-energy
consumer gives RH implication. No numerical computation is used.

  have hkR : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * (k : ℝ) := by
